messages:
Priya: Morning — quick check for tomorrow's panel (11:00am PT). Candidate is PST, scribe + recording consent needed. Also one panelist asked about onsite dietary (nut-free) — can we confirm coverage + debrief owner?
Sam: I can scribe. @Aisha can you confirm recording consent was sent/returned?
Aisha: Sent consent form at 09:12. Candidate signed it and replied. Link to confirmation email thread: https://mail.redwood.com/msg/abc123
Priya: Great — please paste the signed PDF in the candidate doc. AV livestream link: https://meet.redwood.com/room/xyz — I'll update the calendar. Debrief plan: usually 10m sync + 15m debrief; can we compress to 10m debrief to keep panelists on schedule? Debrief owner suggestion: Sam.
Sam: :thumbsup: I can lead a 10m debrief at ~12:10 PT. Quick question — candidate did a small takehome. Which rubric variant do we use for hybrid (takehome + live)?
Aisha: Use the standard "product-eng-live" rubric but flag "takehome" in notes. Suggested weights for this flow: code 60%, system design 25%, communication 15%. Will attach an example scorecard in the candidate doc.
Priya: For score normalization: if someone marks a section N/A, we scale remaining weights to sum to 1. Is that ok? (we've had variance when sections missing)
Sam: Yep. Our normalization rule: mark N/A, then renormalize non-N/A weights proportionally. I'll paste the quick snippet to include in the scorecard:```score_weights: code=0.6, design=0.25, comm=0.15 normalization: if N/A -> scale non_NA_weights to sum=1```
InterviewBot: Reminder: room reserved for "Onsite Interview — Conf Room B" and calendar invites sent to panelists (organizer: priya@redwood.com).
Aisha: AV note for onsite panelists: bring USB-C + HDMI dongles — room has HDMI only. Also dietary: nut-free boxed lunches ordered for panel and candidate.
Priya: Thanks all. Last ask: if anyone needs to swap at the last minute, ping here and change calendar event owner to me so I can reassign scribe quickly.
Sam: Will do. Thanks — see you tomorrow :tada:
